function: Channel estimation: denoises the wavenumber-domain received signal, treated as an image, to recover CSI for XL-MIMO in far-field and near-field (p. 1, 3).
system: Uplink XL-MIMO: BS with 32x32 UPA, single-antenna user, scatterers in far- and near-field, 30 GHz; no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: WDANet: residual CNN with spatial and multi-head channel attention, supervised MSE training; pre-training on a source domain then fine-tuning for new domains (p. 3, 4).
data_channel: Own simulated channel: wavenumber-domain M-FPW model with von Mises-Fisher scatterers (Ns = 3); 18000 training and 2000 test samples per SNR; no public dataset (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Source domain: SNR 0-25 dB, alpha = 400, Ns = 3. Targets: alpha in U(300, 400); Ns = 15 at 1-21 m; 20 fine-tuning epochs (p. 4-6).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, LMMSE, AD-OMP, WD-OMP. Learned: unfolded WD-LAMP, SD-XLCNet, WD-XLCNet (p. 4, 5).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, ablation of attention modules, patch size and insertion mode, NMSE in transfer scenarios, parameters and complexity (p. 5, 6).
complexity: Table I: 582.2 K parameters for WDANet versus 261.4 K for XLCNet and 7.66 M for WD-LAMP; big-O complexity given (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "dataset in source domain Ds are generated according to (6) and (7)"; the paper's own wavenumber-domain M-FPW model with von Mises-Fisher scatterers (p. 2). No 3GPP model, public ray-tracing set or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "the concentration parameters are set as α ∼ U(300, 400)" and "The fine-tuning training epoch is set as Etarget = 20"; p. 6: "applying pre-trained model directly" and a target set with "Ns = 15" at 1-21 m.
q3_support: p. 5: "WDANet achieves an average of 4.13 dB performance improvement compared with WD-XLCNet"; non-learned LS, LMMSE, AD-OMP, WD-OMP (p. 4) and learned WD-LAMP, SD-XLCNet, WD-XLCNet are compared on NMSE (Fig. 3).
q4_support: p. 5: "The number of parameters and computational complexity of DL-based CE schemes are given in Table I"; WDANet 582.2 K parameters with its big-O expression.
q5_support: p. 4: "The training dataset and testing dataset contain 18000 and 2000 samples at each SNR level", generated by the paper's own model; no code or data link, and no public or measured dataset is mentioned.
notes: Area 2 (channel estimation, also unifying far-field and near-field). Table I and the figures read from the page image (p. 5). q2 counted: pre-training on the source domain, then 20 fine-tuning epochs on 2000 samples per SNR level in new environments (p. 5, 6).
